title: ficus ampelos var. bogoriensis
intro: Ficus ampelos var. bogoriensis, commonly known as the Java creeper, is a species of flowering plant in the family Moraceae. It is traditionally used in Indonesian medicine, where it is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and acting as an antipyretic. The therapeutic actions of Ficus ampelos var. bogoriensis include its ability to lower fever, reduce pain, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
